# U.S. Auto Body Repair Industry Consolidation

## Market Structure

- The U.S. collision repair market remains fragmented even as multi-shop operators have expanded through acquisitions [1].
- Caliber describes itself as operating repair centers across dozens of U.S. states, which makes it a relevant consolidator example [1].

## Consolidation Drivers

- CCC Intelligent Solutions reports that repair complexity and technology requirements continue to affect collision repair workflows [2].
- Boyd Group reports U.S. collision repair operations through Gerber Collision & Glass, adding another publicly visible consolidator data point [3].
- The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics tracks automotive body and related repairers as a distinct occupational category, which can anchor labor-market analysis [4].

## Evidence Gaps

- Private-equity ownership dynamics appear material, but the report needs a stronger primary-source dataset before quantifying sponsor-backed share.
- The Automotive Service Association publishes industry information that can help triangulate repair-shop operating pressure [5].

[1]: https://www.caliber.com/about-us
[2]: https://www.cccis.com/news-and-insights/
[3]: https://www.boydgroup.com/
[4]: https://www.bls.gov/ooh/installation-maintenance-and-repair/automotive-body-and-glass-repairers.htm
[5]: https://www.asashop.org/
